summary: A reply from Rand to RFC 111, which asked sites for implementation schedules. It restates the memo's two goals: realistic schedules, and sharing of techniques that worked. The author had not yet prodded sites because the schedules depend on Telnet, and no Telnet specification was available to everyone.

eli5.summary: A helper answers the teacher: I understand the due-date plan, but we cannot say when we will finish because we still do not have the instructions for one part.

questions: why were implementation schedules delayed in 1971
what was the response to rfc 111
